verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions npm workspaces, a shared monorepo lockfile, or automatic cross-linking of local packages. `npm link` (npm-docs-8) is a related but different single-package linking feature. Keeping small modules inside a project (npm-comm-18) is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage many packages in one monorepo with workspaces sharing a single lockfile and cross-linked local dependencies
